notes: both branches write Shu'ba, then the names from Hakam to Aisha are written once, so they are the shared tail of both (rule 3); the tail is read as the continuation of the second Shu'ba
«حدثنا أبي» : bare father of the second branch, relation
«واللفظ له» is Muslim's note on wording, left out; «- واللفظ له -» carries no name
